metadata.title: Tracing intermediate-mass black holes in the Galactic Centre

notes: No eligible stars. The paper presents simulations of IMBHs and populations of simulated HVSs, but it does not identify any individual star by name or source identifier or study a specifically identified previously known Galactic-unbound star. The “one star” mentioned at T:p2-b0 as possibly ejected from the Large Magellanic Cloud is unnamed, while the HVS discussion there and the HVS distributions shown at I:p7-b0 are sample/population-level. Sgr A* (e.g., T:p6-b5) is the Galactic SMBH, not an unbound star.
